name: Hyaluronic Acid
generalPurpose: Attracts and binds water to the skin, providing hydration.
generalUsageInformation: Best applied to damp skin. Can be used daily, morning and night.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: Generally well-tolerated, but can draw moisture out of the skin in very dry climates if not sealed with an occlusive.

name: Glycerin
generalPurpose: Draws moisture into the skin, improving hydration and barrier function.
generalUsageInformation: Commonly found in many skincare products. Safe for daily use.

name: Ceramides
generalPurpose: Lipids that help form the skin's barrier and retain moisture.
generalUsageInformation: Can be used daily, morning and night.

name: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)
generalPurpose: Helps build keratin, improves lipid barrier, and can reduce redness and blotchiness.
generalUsageInformation: Can be used daily, morning and/or night. Concentrations between 2% and 5% are generally effective and well-tolerated.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: High concentrations (10%+) may cause irritation or flushing in some individuals.

name: Salicylic Acid (BHA)
generalPurpose: Oil-soluble acid that penetrates pores to exfoliate dead skin cells and reduce sebum.
generalUsageInformation: Use 1-3 times a week initially, can increase frequency if tolerated. Often found in concentrations of 0.5% to 2%.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: Can cause dryness, peeling, or irritation.

name: Glycolic Acid (AHA)
generalPurpose: Water-soluble acid that exfoliates the surface of the skin, improving texture and tone.
generalUsageInformation: Use 1-3 times a week. Often found in concentrations of 5% to 10%.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: Can cause stinging, redness, and peeling, especially at higher concentrations or low pH.
importantWarnings: Increases sun sensitivity. Daily sunscreen is essential.

name: Lactic Acid (AHA)
generalPurpose: A gentler water-soluble acid that exfoliates while also providing some hydration.
generalUsageInformation: Can be used 1-3 times a week. Often found in concentrations of 5% to 10%.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: Generally gentler than glycolic acid, but can still cause irritation.
importantWarnings: Increases sun sensitivity. Daily sunscreen is essential.

name: Retinol
generalPurpose: Promotes cell turnover and collagen production, improving texture and signs of aging.
generalUsageInformation: Use only at night. Start with a low concentration.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: High potential for dryness, redness, and peeling (retinization process).
importantWarnings: Do not use with other strong exfoliants in the same routine initially. Increases sun sensitivity. Daily sunscreen is mandatory. Not recommended during pregnancy.

name: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)
generalPurpose: Antioxidant that helps protect against free radicals and can brighten skin tone.
generalUsageInformation: Often used in the morning under sunscreen.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: Pure ascorbic acid requires a low pH to be effective, which can cause stinging or irritation in sensitive skin.

name: Centella Asiatica (Cica)
generalPurpose: Known for its soothing and wound-healing properties.
generalUsageInformation: Safe for daily use, morning and night.

name: Squalane
generalPurpose: A lightweight oil that mimics skin's natural sebum, providing moisture without feeling heavy.
generalUsageInformation: Can be used daily, morning and night.

name: Petrolatum
generalPurpose: Creates a physical barrier on the skin to prevent transepidermal water loss (TEWL).
generalUsageInformation: Typically used as the last step in a nighttime routine.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: May feel too heavy for oily or blemish-prone skin.

name: Titanium Dioxide
generalPurpose: Mineral/physical UV filter that reflects and scatters UV rays.
generalUsageInformation: Apply generously as the last step in a morning routine.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: Generally well-tolerated by sensitive skin. Can leave a white cast.

name: Zinc Oxide
generalPurpose: Mineral/physical UV filter offering broad-spectrum protection; also has soothing properties.
generalUsageInformation: Apply generously as the last step in a morning routine.
possibleIrritationConsiderations: Generally well-tolerated. Can leave a white cast.
